extension.summary: Majan - an editorial index for your library.
extension.description: A near-black page, one accent colour, big type and hairlines. Built for movies, TV shows and music on the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v1.0.9 - Library panel (Left or Right past the edge of a view, or OPTIONS): update and clean the library, view, sort, order, show, search; VIEW opens a picker with previews; Update / Clean library in the System menu.
